name: Microsoft
description: Microsoft sells software and cloud computing to businesses and consumers. The largest profit pool is subscriptions: Microsoft 365 (Office, Teams, security), Dynamics business apps and LinkedIn. The fastest-growing pool is the Azure cloud, where customers rent computing, storage and AI services by usage, plus server software and enterprise support. The rest is Windows (mostly licensed to PC makers), Xbox games and hardware, and Bing and Edge search advertising. FY2026 revenue was $331.8B, and 54% of operating profit came from the Productivity and Business Processes segment even though Intelligent Cloud is nearly the same size in revenue. It holds a large, long-term strategic partnership with OpenAI, and is spending heavily on data centers for AI.
